title: Bloch and Landau constants for meromorphic functions
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}_1(λ)$ be the class of all meromorphic functions $f$ in the unit disk $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}\}: |z|<1$ having a simple pole at $λ\in \overline{\mathbb{D}} \setminus \{0\}$ and satisfying the normalization $f'(0)=1$. Let $B(λ)$ and $L(λ)$ denote the Bloch and Landau constants, respectively, for this class. In this article, we first show that the Bloch constant $B(1)$ and the Landau constant $L(1)$ are infinite.
